(module asl-target-llvm/tests/exitCodeTest
                                                                                                          
  :x [runTests]
  :i [])

fn host -> String
  "asl/host/out/asl-host"

fn clang -> String
  "/usr/bin/clang -Wno-override-module"

fn lib -> String
  "asl/host/out/libaslhost.a"

fn ! sh cmd: String -> ProcessOutput
  (processRun cmd)

fn okProgram -> String
  "(module test/okProg :d \"ok prog\" :x [entry] :i [])\n\nfn ! entry -> (Result Int64 String)\n  (ok 42)\n"

fn okNonIntProgram -> String
  "(module test/okNonIntProg :d \"ok non-int prog\" :x [entry] :i [])\n\nfn ! entry -> (Result String String)\n  (ok \"done\")\n"

fn errProgram -> String
  "(module test/errProg :d \"err prog\" :x [entry] :i [])\n\nfn ! entry -> (Result Int64 String)\n  (err \"boom\")\n"

fn mainNameProgram -> String
  "(module test/mainNameProg :d \"main name prog\" :x [main] :i [])\n\nfn ! main -> (Result Int64 String)\n  (ok 7)\n"

fn mainRawProgram -> String
  "(module test/mainRawProg :d \"main raw prog\" :x [main] :i [])\n\nfn ! main -> Int64\n  13\n"

fn buildDriver -> String
  "asl/packages/asl-compiler/src/asl1.asl"

fn ! compileAndRun work: String name: String src: String -> ProcessOutput
  (let [(srcFile (str work "/" name ".asl"))
        (llFile (str work "/" name ".ll"))
        (binFile (str work "/" name))
        (w (fileWriteString srcFile src))
        (build (sh (str (host) " run " (buildDriver) " build " srcFile " -o " llFile)))
        (link (sh (str (clang) " -x ir " llFile " -x none " (lib) " -lm -o " binFile)))]
    (sh binFile))

fn ! compareWithHost work: String name: String src: String -> Bool
  (let [(srcFile (str work "/" name ".asl"))
        (w (fileWriteString srcFile src))
        (hostOut (sh (str (host) " run " srcFile)))
        (nativeOut (compileAndRun work name src))]
    (do
      (assert (= nativeOut.exitCode     hostOut.exitCode    )
              (str name ": exit code native " nativeOut.exitCode     " vs host " hostOut.exitCode    ))
      (assert (= nativeOut.stdout     hostOut.stdout    )
              (str name ": stdout native '" nativeOut.stdout     "' vs host '" hostOut.stdout     "'"))
      true)))

fn ! runTests -> Bool
  (let [(made (sh "mktemp -d"))
        (work (stringReplace made.stdout     "\n" ""))]
    (do
      (assert (= made.exitCode     0) "mktemp -d makes a work directory")
      (assert (compareWithHost work "okProg" (okProgram)) "ok 42 matches host run")
      (assert (compareWithHost work "okNonIntProg" (okNonIntProgram)) "ok non-int matches host run")
      (assert (compareWithHost work "errProg" (errProgram)) "err matches host run")
      (assert (compareWithHost work "mainProg" (mainNameProgram)) "entry named main returning Result matches host run")
      (assert (compareWithHost work "mainRawProg" (mainRawProgram)) "entry named main returning Int64 matches host run")
      (assert (= (sh (str "rm -rf " work)).exitCode     0) "work directory removed")
      true))
